# Clinique Vétérinaire Maârif

Veterinary clinic in the Maârif district of Casablanca, Morocco. Small-animal care since 2002: dogs, cats and NAC (exotic pets).

- Phone: +212 5 22 23 30 95
- Emergency line (7/7): +212 6 61 49 26 18
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/212661492618
- Email: vetclinicmaarif@gmail.com
- Address: 60, Boulevard Bir Anzarane, Maârif, Casablanca 20330, Morocco
- Hours: Monday-Friday 9:00-19:00, Saturday 9:00-14:00
- Languages: Arabic, French, English, Russian
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Clinique+Veterinaire+Maarif+60+Boulevard+Bir+Anzarane+Casablanca

## Services

Consultations, vaccination, surgery, laboratory, imaging (X-ray), dentistry, ophthalmology, hospitalization, pharmacy, nutrition, grooming, laser therapy, emergency care.
